{{Top|leg}}
'''Ezzar's spies''' were a network of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] who operated in the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The spies served the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]], who chose not to reveal his true identity to his minions and represented himself to them as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] thug, causing the spies to refer to him as "the Jedi in black."
